title: tracelog
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, organizationid, parenttracelogid, regardingobjectid_emailserverprofile, regardingobjectid_mailbox.

canbedeleted.description: Indicates if this trace log can be deleted.

createdon.description: Time the error is created and logged.

isunique.description: Tells if this traceLog is created uniquely(only one) for the associated entity.

modifiedon.description: Time the error is updated and logged for the same regarding object.

traceactionxml.description: XML representation of the trace actions.

tracedetailxml.description: XML representation of the trace details.

traceparameterhash.description: Stores the hash of the entity object associated with this tracelog.

traceparameterxml.description: XML representation of the trace parameters.

utcconversiontimezonecode.description: Time zone code that was in use when the trace was created.

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the trace.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the trace.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who modified the trace.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who modified the trace.

_organizationid_value.description: Unique identifier of the organization associated with the trace.

_parenttracelogid_value.description: Indicates the parent ID of the trace log.

_regardingobjectid_value.description: Regarding mailbox or email server profile.
